violation_type.title: Discipline - Use Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §742.601(4))
violation_type.short_title: Discipline - Use Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed in relation to the allegation and found to be deficient. The caregiver did not use positive methods of discipline when correcting the students behaviors.
